title: Core network possibly rendering SIM unuseable
body:
Hello,

I am having an issue with some element(presumably of the open5gs core) rendering SIM cards unusable.

I am using open5gs together with SRSran project to test some 5G UEs. I have ran into an issue with one of the two identical systems that i am using in which after a failed registration request or some restart of the system the SIM car no longer functions, in neither of my two systems.

I am inserting a snippet of the amf log. The registration failure has been due to a wrong letter in the OPC code in the core network registration which has since been solved. The main issue here is that now the system will not talk to the SIM card anymore. No other changes have taken place and since then i have restarted all the core and gnb services. The same SIM card no longer functions in any of my two systems. I ran into this issue before but have not been able to find a connection with anything until now.

Can you please advise if any of the components of the core network can effectively "block" a sim card from connecting or if I can provide any more resources and logs, please let me know. 


SIM: sysmoISIM-SJA5-9FV
UE: Nokia FastMile 5G26-A
USRP: Ettus Research B200
